title: OnlyApes
tagline: Fan club feedback based on token ownership using Lens Protocol
description: Uses Lens Protocol. It is based off their (well, Aave's) lens repo where I brought in all the contracts to a typescripted version of scaffold-eth. I brought in the lens custom tasks into the hardhat project. Then I got everything deploying to a local hardhat network and replicated the tasks then created some custom tasks. The vite app was made to support some lens behavior.
